environment.description: Same Quarkus handler deployed on AWS Lambda with custom OCI image. The container's seccomp profile drops CAP_NET_RAW and CAP_SYS_ADMIN. Deployed behind API Gateway REST API (not HTTP API) with a request validator resource configured with 'validateRequestParameters: true' and a Gateway Response override for 4xx that strips the Location header from any non-2xx response. Additionally, a CloudFront distribution sits in front with a Lambda@Edge origin-request function that performs strict URI canonicalization — double-decode prevention and enforcement that the redirect_uri query parameter host must exactly match a pinned allowlist ('^https://[a-z0-9-]+\.app\.example\.com/.*$') before forwarding to origin. The Lambda@Edge function returns 403 for any request where redirect_uri doesn't pass the regex after full URL decoding.

config.lambda_edge_origin_request: strict URI canonicalization with pinned allowlist regex: ^https://[a-z0-9-]+\.app\.example\.com/.*$
config.lambda_edge_behavior: returns 403 if redirect_uri fails regex after full URL decode
